title: Open physics data: what license and attribution terms should it carry? Contributions
description: Contributions, license catalog, and codebook from the moderated discussion at SESAPS 2026 (Kennesaw State University, Nov 12-14, 2026) on what license and attribution terms should accompany open physics data. Each contribution is a one-page perspective in the contributor's own words, approved before posting. The survey codebook and coded catalog are archived separately (det-lab/open-physics-data-codebook).
